protocolBasis.rule: createFromFetch consumes text/x-component; response.a is actionResult, response.f is Flight data
normalizeFlightData returns string unchanged; empty string means no router patch
Server action root envelope a:actionResult promise, f:flightData
Fetch action redirect uses303 and x-action-redirect

intendedReply: 0:{"a":"$@1","f":""} newline 1:<plain contract result> newline; literal leading-dollar strings escaped
creditRule: Only an actually intercepted same-origin native POST fulfilled locally, then real rendered decided UI plus expected focus. Neither arbitrary JSON nor this static wire description is a pass. Missed interception/unsupported body is a setup gap. Actual decided UI with wrong focus is a measured product failure, not a fixture gap.
transportScope: Result replies for structured withdrawal/shift changes; source-prescribed local redirect replies for void Availability/Timeoff actions. No server calls or app writes.
status: Prepared statically; not imported, decoded, tested or run in a browser
proofScope: 16 structured withdrawal withdrawn/conflict +8 weekly Availability redirect configurations; each actual intercepted native POST, actual response headers, actual decided UI, expected focus and exact own fixture binding; no server writes
